7016.title: Split-drag cancellation leaks into route navigation
7016.rootCauseOneLine: Split-drag engagement sends an unconsumed synthetic Escape that invokes the section Back to app shortcut.
7016.proposedFix: Mark the cancelable internal Escape default-prevented before dispatch; preserve dnd-kit cancellation while suppressing global navigation.
7016.caveats: Real AppLayout DOM regression and a labeled production-component Chromium harness; not a full-app macOS E2E. Reproduction code is inline under the report repository's artifact policy.
